comparator.sourceNotes: The new Dutch-taught Leiden route National and International Politics has ten current first-year requirements totaling60 EC. The formal annex publishes later years for IRO and for the outgoing Political Science/International Politics routes, whose intake ended with 2025–2026; those curricula are not substituted for the new route. Applicable Years2 and3 remain unpublished.
